# ---------------- move generation ----------------
def move_rule(changes, conds=(), meta=(), ep="--", mids=None):
    """changes: {idx: (class, newval)}; newval literal str or int (copy char from idx).
    conds: [(idx, class)] board lookaheads; meta: [(offset, literal)]"""
    look = "".join("(?=%s%s)" % (skip(i), c) for i, c in conds)
    look += "".join("(?=%s%s)" % (skip(o), s) for o, s in meta)
    order = sorted(changes)
    pat = ""
    g = 0
    pos = 0
    gap_groups = []
    char_group = {}
    for i in order:
        g += 1
        pat += "(%s)" % (mids[i] if mids and i in mids else skip(i - pos))
        gap_groups.append(g)
        g += 1
        pat += "(%s)" % changes[i][0]
        char_group[i] = g
        pos = i + 1
    g += 1
    pat += "(%s ....) .." % skip(BOARD_END + 1 - pos)
    rest_g = g
    rep = r"\g<0>" + "\n"
    for k, i in enumerate(order):
        rep += r"\g<%d>" % gap_groups[k]
        nv = changes[i][1]
        if isinstance(nv, int):
            rep += r"\g<%d>" % char_group[nv]
        else:
            rep += nv
    rep += r"\g<%d> %s" % (rest_g, ep)
    R(r"\A" + look + pat, rep)
